question: The term 'tackle point' is associated with ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kabaddi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tackle point** refers to a situation in** Kabaddi** where a defender successfully stops an opponent raider from **crossing the midline** of the court.
 
• Kabaddi is a **contact sport **that originated in India and is now played professionally in several countries.
 
• India has competed in kabaddi at** four Asian Games** and has **won gold** each time.
 
• India plays **four **different types of kabaddi:** Amar, Suranjeevi, Huttuttoo, and Gaminee**.
 
• Points in Kabaddi game is: **Out, Bonus, All out, Technical, Super Tackle** and if any team does not gain score in** 3 consecutive attacks**, then **1 point** is given to the opposing team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football is** also known as** soccer.**

 
 
• It involves players using their feet to kick a **ball and score goals.**
 
 
 
• **Baseball** is a **bat-and-ball** game.
 
 
• It is played between two teams of** nine players each,** with the aim of scoring runs by hitting the ball thrown by the pitcher.
 
 
 
• **Hockey** is a team sport played on **ice or field.**
 
 
• **​**Here players use sticks to hit a ball or puck into the **opposing team's goal.**
